ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: People's Bank of China and State Administration for Market Regulation, Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Legal Persons and Other Organizations (PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 [2024]), effective 1 November 2024; Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (revised 2024), effective 1 January 2025; Company Law of the People's Republic of China (revised 2023), effective 1 July 2024; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China, effective 1 January 2020; Interim Measures for the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration (SAMR Order No. 34, 2020).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local municipal Market Supervision Administration (SAMR), issuing the unified business license and incorporation certificate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular_Only: PRC notary public notarization, then PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular legalization, then Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification in Taiwan. Hague Apostille is not applicable because Taiwan is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; the two paths must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System / local Market Supervision Administration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular_Only: PRC notary public notarization, then PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular legalization, then Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification in Taiwan. Hague Apostille is not available for Taiwan-bound documents and must not be added sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors of the parent company or sole shareholder appointing the incorporation agent and authorizing the WFOE formation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular_Only: notarization of corporate signatures and certificates by a PRC or recognized foreign notary, followed by PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular legalization and Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification. Apostille is not to be used because the destination jurisdiction, Taiwan, is not an Apostille Convention contracting party.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Investors/shareholders, as approved and filed with SAMR for the WFOE
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular_Only: PRC notary public notarization of the shareholders' execution pages, PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular legalization, then Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification. No Hague Apostille chain is permissible for documents required by Taiwan authorities or banks.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank of the parent investor or a licensed PRC bank branch under PBOC supervision
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular_Only: notarization of the bank officer's signature and bank seal, PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular legalization, then Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification. The Hague Apostille path is a mutually exclusive alternative and must not be combined with consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Tax Registration / Tax Compliance Certificate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China or the parent investor's competent tax authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular_Only: PRC notary public notarization of the tax certificate, PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs consular legalization, then Straits Exchange Foundation (SEF) verification. Apostille certification cannot be used for Taiwan-bound legalization.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, shareholders, senior management, counterparties and suppliers in the dried goji berry and herbal botanical wholesale chain must be screened against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, PRC anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism published Lists, and Taiwan-incorporated financial examination designation lists. Politically exposed persons (PEPs) must be identified using government position databases and commercial PEP screening tools covering immediate family members and close associates. The screening must be repeated at onboarding, before every significant corporate action, and continuously through real-time automated monitoring. For any high-risk or PEP-matching party, enhanced due diligence is mandatory, including source of wealth, source of funds, transactional pattern analysis and full beneficial ownership verification. Any suspicion must be documented and reported to the China Anti-Money Laundering Monitoring and Analysis Center through the suspicious transaction report mechanism within 24 hours of detection.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Name Reservation System operated by the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and accessible through the SAMR one-stop enterprise registration portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered legal name of a WFOE must be in Chinese. An English name may appear only as a registered translation and cannot replace the Chinese statutory name. The four-tier mandatory naming convention is: administrative division + specific trade name + industry or business activity + enterprise type or liability suffix. Foreign investor names must be transliterated into standard pinyin using ordinary Mandarin pronunciation; Latin-only names, sequential initials, Arabic-numeral-only names and names lacking a Chinese administrative division prefix are rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Under the SAMR name registration rules, a rejection notice may be challenged by filing administrative reconsideration with the reviewing SAMR authority within 60 days of receipt. Attach the rejection notice, enterprise pre-registration code, proposed Chinese and English names, business scope, lease contract, notarized UBO identification and any ministerial approval letter for sensitive tokens. If reconsideration is denied, appeal to the competent People's Court within six months. Simultaneously reserve a new name with at least three alternatives because the original 30-day reservation cannot be extended. For refusal based on an identical or similar existing name, submit a written consent letter from the prior rights holder or amend the industry suffix and trade name to differentiate.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for this industry. PRC Company Law and SAMR implementing rules require a fixed, actual, non-residential address for a WFOE engaged in the international bulk export of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals. The State Taxation Administration will deny VAT general taxpayer registration and export tax refund eligibility if the registered address is a virtual office or commercial mailbox. Commercial banks applying KYC rules will reject the corporate account because the physical office, employees and business premises cannot be inspected. The registered office must be a commercial lease registered with the local housing authority, evidenced by rent invoices, tenant occupancy proof and notarized lease documents, and must also support the food/herbal business license and customs registration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High. Checklist: (1) original registered lease contract and landlord property ownership certificate; (2) physical office signage, business license display, desks, archives and operating equipment; (3) payroll records, social insurance declarations and labor contracts; (4) supply contracts, warehouse receipts and inventory records for dried goji berries and herbal botanicals; (5) export customs declarations, phytosanitary certificates and food business license; (6) bank statements, VAT invoices and export tax refund files. Quantified risk: approximately 80% probability of an unannounced joint tax and registry inspection within the first 12 months, 65% probability of a market supervision food-safety inspection, and 50% probability of a customs audit of export and phytosanitary records.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Food/herbal wholesale business license official application fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory official fee; required licensing is processed without state-imposed fee.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act of Taiwan, Articles 1, 6, 7, 18, 98 through 113 (formation, capital, directors and limited-liability rules) and Article 161 (share certificates); Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, Article 7; however, because the ultimate parent is a People's Republic of China enterprise, the controlling authorization is the Regulations Governing the Permission of Investment in Taiwan by Mainland Area Enterprises, Articles 3, 5, 8 and 14 (sector eligibility, capital remittance and post-investment supervision); Act Governing Food Safety and Sanitation, Article 8 (food business operator registration); International Trade Act, Articles 6 and 10 (exporter registration and certificates of origin); Agricultural Production and Certification Act (organic certification); Fire Services Act and Occupational Safety and Health Act (premises and workplace clearance); Waste Disposal Act (hazardous residue handling).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Affairs (Administration for Commerce), acting through the MOEA One-Stop E-Government Company and Business Registration System; mainland-investor approval is separately issued by the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Registration Application (Establishment Registration Form for a Limited Company) filed via the MOEA One-Stop E-Government portal together with the capital-verification report, Articles of Incorporation, investment approval letter and ancillary dossiers.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None - Taiwan repealed the statutory minimum paid-in capital requirement in 2009; however, for a mainland-China-invested company, the subscribed capital must be fully remitted from outside Taiwan through approved banking channels and exchanged into New Taiwan Dollars in a preparatory bank account before the incorporation registration is certified. No blocked escrow account is required; the funds must simply remain in the corporate preparatory account until the certified public accountant completes the capital-verification report, and the investment approval letter must state the approved NT-dollar exchange ceiling.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF CN WFOE LIMITED (the 'Company'), duly convened on the date of incorporation at the registered office located in Taipei, Taiwan, with written notice waived by all directors and with every then-appointed director present in person, constituting a full quorum under the Articles of Incorporation. The Chair declared the meeting lawfully constituted and the following resolutions were moved, seconded, and adopted unanimously as ordinary resolutions of the Board: 1. SUBSCRIPTION OF SHARE CAPITAL. RESOLVED, that the Board acknowledged the approved registered share capital of the Company, being New Taiwan Dollars [amount], divided into [number] ordinary shares at NT$10 par value each, and that the sole shareholder, the mainland Chinese parent company identified in the investment application, has subscribed for one hundred percent of such shares at par; that the remittance certificate, foreign-exchange settlement slip, and bank deposit certificate on file are accepted as proof of full payment of the subscription price; that the officers are directed to procure the statutory capital-verification report and to issue share certificates in accordance with the Companies Act and the Articles of Incorporation. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. RESOLVED, that the corporate bank designated in the preparatory banking agreement is hereby approved as the principal depositary bank, and that the Managing Director and the Company Secretary are, any two acting together, authorized to open corporate current, foreign-currency, and receivable accounts, to execute banking mandates, to approve inward and outward SWIFT TT and wire-transfer instructions for export receivables, to sign any necessary indemnities, and to manage all treasury transactions of the Company. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. RESOLVED, that the premises at [registered address], Taipei, Taiwan, be and is hereby adopted as the registered office and principal place of business of the Company; that the lease agreement and the landlord consent letter exhibited to this meeting are approved; and that the Company Secretary shall file the registration and any future changes with the Ministry of Economic Affairs as required by law. 4. APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS. RESOLVED, that [director name] is appointed Managing Director and legal representative, [secretary name] is appointed Company Secretary, [compliance name] is appointed Compliance Officer, and [signatory name] is appointed Authorized Signatory for export and customs declarations, each to serve until resignation or removal by the shareholder; that such officers are authorized to execute the incorporation application, tax and food business registrations, exporter registration, bank account opening, and all ancillary instruments; that the common seal and the company chop may be affixed by the Managing Director or the Company Secretary; and that all actions taken in good faith prior to this meeting to prepare the Company for operation are hereby ratified, confirmed, and adopted as acts of the Company. The Chair certified that these resolutions were duly passed and that they are conclusive and binding upon the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name and Business Scope Pre-approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Affairs, One-Stop E-Government Company Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the online pre-approval application through the MOEA One-Stop E-Government Company Registration Portal, selecting three candidate company names in order of preference, each meeting the distinctiveness test and avoiding identical or strikingly similar names already registered for analogous business categories. Declare the business scope as international wholesale and export of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals corresponding to ISIC 4631 and NAICS 424490. The verifying authority checks name availability and scope legality; the pre-approval notice is valid for six months and must anchor the subsequent incorporation registration, with the applicant keeping the notice reference number for all later filings.
required_dossiers: Completed application for company name and business scope pre-approval
Power of attorney if filed through a registered agent
Notarized identification or company registration abstract of the mainland investor
Proposed English company name and three Chinese-transliterated candidate names
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for conflict, the applicant may submit an amended pre-approval application with revised names free of conflict within 7 days; the pre-approval notice is valid for 6 months and may be renewed once upon written request. If the business scope description is queried, narrow the trading description and re-submit with supporting botanical classification references.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mainland Investor Investment Approval by the Investment Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA-IC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit through the Investment Commission the mainland-investor application package, attaching the notarized business certificate of the PRC parent, audited financial statements, the capital remittance schedule, source-of-funds bank confirmation, and the proposed Articles of Incorporation describing the dried-goji and herbal-botanicals wholesale and export plan. The Commission examines the sector against the negative list applicable to mainland capital, evaluates capital sufficiency and national-security sensitivity, and if approved issues an investment approval letter specifying the NT-dollar equivalent amount permitted for exchange settlement. The approval letter must be presented to the foreign-exchange bank to open the preparatory account and receive the inbound remittance before company registration.
required_dossiers: Notarized mainland investor company registration certificate and seal certificate
Audited financial statements of the mainland investor for the most recent fiscal year
Investment application form and schedule of share subscription
Source-of-funds documentation and bank reference letter
Proposed Articles of Incorporation and business plan for dried goji berry export
Power of attorney appointing the local filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MOEA-IC issues a deficiency query, the applicant must respond within 60 days with supplementary documents; an approval suspension may be lifted upon compliance, and a final denial may be appealed to the Executive Yuan Review Board within 30 days of service.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Incorporation Registration with the Ministry of Economic Affairs
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Affairs, One-Stop Company Registration System
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Company Incorporation Registration Application through the MOEA One-Stop E-Government System within fifteen days after the approved capital has been exchanged and deposited in the preparatory bank account and the CPA capital-verification report has been signed. Append the MOEA investment approval letter, foreign-exchange settlement certificate, bank deposit certificate, Articles of Incorporation signed by the sole shareholder, the list of directors and authorized officers, registered-office landlord consent, and the lease. The registry examines compliance with the Companies Act, verifies paid-in capital authenticity, then grants the company registration certificate and automatically assigns the unified business number and corporate seal-chop registration.
required_dossiers: Company incorporation registration application form
Capital verification report issued by a Taiwan certified public accountant
MOEA investment approval letter and foreign-exchange settlement certificate
Bank certificate of paid-in capital in the preparatory account
Signed Articles of Incorporation
List of shareholders, directors and officers with identification copies
Registered office lease and landlord written consent
Registration fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries or suspends the application, the applicant must rectify the identified deficiencies within 15 days of written notification; a refusal may be cured by re-filing a fresh application after correction, and administrative appeal lies to the MOEA Department of Commercial Affairs within 30 days of service.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Importer-Exporter Registration with the Bureau of Foreign Trade
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bureau of Foreign Trade (BOFT), Ministry of Economic Affairs
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply online on the BOFT Foreign Traders portal for exporter registration using the company's unified business number and corporate seal card, designating the authorized signatory for export declarations and stating the principal export commodities as dried lycium and goji berries and herbal botanicals with the corresponding commodity classification codes. BOFT accredits the exporter and validates the signatory authority; completion enables lawful issuance of export permits, certificates of origin, and customs declarations for bulk shipments, and supports the eventual SWIFT telegraphic transfer and wire settlement of foreign receivables.
required_dossiers: Company registration certificate and unified business number certificate
Completed exporter registration form with commodity codes
List of authorized signatories for export declarations
Company chop and seal-chop registration card
Approved business scope showing ISIC 4631 wholesale activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: BOFT will issue a correction notice returnable within 14 days; failure to respond results in rejection, which may be appealed administratively to MOEA. Registration can be reinstated upon demonstrating the absence of outstanding customs obligations and payment of the applicable late fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Food Business Registration with the Taiwan Food and Drug Administration and Organic Certification Verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA), Ministry of Health and Welfare, jointly with the Council of Agriculture (COA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register in the TFDA online Food Business Operator Registration system under Article 8 of the Act Governing Food Safety and Sanitation, declaring the company as a wholesale distributor and exporter of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals, attaching company data and the process-flow declaration; the system immediately issues the food business registration number that customs checks at export. In parallel, for batches marketed as organic, verify that the lycium source holds valid organic certification issued by a COA-accredited body and file the equivalence or import-attribute certificate recognized by the destination customs authority before shipment.
required_dossiers: Company registration certificate with unified business number
Food business operator online registration form
Product ingredient and botanical species declaration
Organic certificate issued by a COA-accredited certifying body for organic-labeled batches
Export batch labeling and specification sheets
Warehouse sanitation self-inspection record if storage is maintained
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: TFDA may issue an online amendment notice returnable within 7 days; for substantive non-compliance the food business registration number can be suspended, and the operator may restore it by submitting corrective standard operating procedures and, if fraud is alleged, by presenting a written defense before an administrative hearing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA), Ministry of Health and Welfare, jointly with the Bureau of Foreign Trade (BOFT), Ministry of Economic Affairs; environmental aspects are overseen by the Ministry of Environment (formerly Taiwan EPA); fire and workplace clearance is administered by the local municipal fire authority and the Occupational Safety and Health Administration in the registered-office and warehousing district.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business Registration Number (Food Business Operator Certificate) under Article 8 of the Act Governing Food Safety and Sanitation; Exporter Registration under Article 6 of the International Trade Act; Organic Product Certification issued by a COA-accredited body for organic-labeled export batches; Civil Defense Fire Safety Equipment Certificate under the Fire Services Act.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment, Taiwan (Environmental Protection Administration)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category Not Listed: ISIC 4631 wholesale trade of agricultural raw materials is a commercial trading activity not listed in Annex I or Annex II of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act, so neither a full EIA report nor an environmental registration is a precondition for company formation or the trading/export license. A general obligation to prevent pollution and to dispose of office and packaging waste lawfully applies; industrial manufacturing, chemical, assembly and ISIC 52xx warehousing EIA tiers are not applicable to this pure wholesale entity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to wholesale and trading operations with no industrial process; if the company later adds a repacking, fumigation or herbal-processing annex, wastewater discharged into the public sewer must meet municipal standards (pH 6.0-9.0, BOD not exceeding 150 mg/L, SS not exceeding 90 mg/L), and any VOC-emitting process must keep total emissions below 20 kg per hour to retain Category B exemption status; hazardous waste such as pesticide-contaminated packaging must be handled under the Waste Disposal Act through licensed contractors with manifests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Equipment and Evacuation Plan Certification under the Fire Services Act for the registered office and any storage premises; structural and load-bearing inspection certificate for mezzanine or bulk botanical storage issued by a licensed architect or civil engineer; Occupational Safety and Health Act compliance for warehouse handlers including hazard communication, personal protective equipment, and first-aid provisions; and, if any pest-control fumigants are stored, a hazardous-substance storage approval and spill-containment plan from the local municipal fire and environmental offices.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; online electronic portal: National Unified Electronic Tax Bureau (e-Tax), with export/customs filings made through the China International Trade Single Window.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The China WFOE is a PRC resident enterprise and is not treated as a foreign non-resident. It obtains its tax identification number automatically at incorporation: the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) is the TIN, after completing the one-time taxpayer information registration with the local STA office within 30 days of the SAMR business-license issuance. The steps are: (1) incorporate with the State Administration for Market Regulation and obtain the USCC; (2) register for taxpayer status with the competent STA tax service hall or e-Tax portal, supplying the business license, articles of association, equity structure, accounting/tax filing information, and bank account certificate; (3) receive the Tax Registration Confirmation and activate an e-Tax account; (4) if the WFOE will export goods, file the Export Tax Refund/Exemption Registration through e-Tax or the International Trade Single Window; (5) for any foreign (including Taiwan) non-resident entity with China-source income but no establishment, that foreign entity must separately complete Non-resident Enterprise Tax Registration (or withholding registration) with the payer's STA office to obtain its non-resident TIN before payments are remitted. A pure export sale from the WFOE to Taiwan does not itself trigger Taiwan national tax registration for the WFOE unless the WFOE later creates a Taiwan permanent establishment or physical branch.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (PRC resident enterprise; taxed under Corporate Income Tax on worldwide income at the statutory 25% rate; no pass-through, partnership, or disregarded-entity treatment for a limited-liability WFOE).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None comparable to US check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections. The PRC tax system imposes entity-level taxation by default. The only elective status available is the VAT general-taxpayer election for newly formed enterprises below the RMB 5,000,000 compulsory threshold, and the small low-profit enterprise CIT preferential rate is a statutory classification rather than a free election. Export tax-refund methodology is dictated by the entity's production or trading activity.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) under the PRC VAT Law and Implementing Regulations; for exports, the Export Tax Rebate (Exemption, Set-off, Refund) regime.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VAT registration is mandatory for every legally established WFOE from the date of incorporation; there is no turnover exemption for a PRC resident enterprise. The RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable-sales threshold is the mandatory boundary for General vs Small-scale VAT taxpayer status: annual taxable sales above RMB 5,000,000 require General taxpayer status; below it, the WFOE may still elect General status, which is practically necessary to claim input-VAT credits and export tax refunds. Dried goji berries/herbal botanicals that qualify as primary agricultural products are eligible for the reduced 9% VAT rate on domestic sales, but export sales are zero-rated.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT invoices must be issued through the STA's VAT Invoice System integrated with the Golden Tax Phase IV platform, using the National Unified Electronic Tax Bureau. Fully digitalized e-invoices carry a unique invoice number and digital signature and are uploaded to the STA in real time; software integrators use STA-approved APIs, and all invoice issuance must occur in the e-Tax account or through STA-certified service providers. No physical fiscal stamp is applied; the anti-fraud control is the real-time issuance, authentication, and cross-matching of invoice data to customs declarations, export logistics, and foreign-exchange receipts through the International Trade Single Window data-sharing mechanism. Export invoices are issued as 0% export-rated e-invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A PRC WFOE exporting dried goji berries/herbal botanicals from mainland China customs territory to Taiwan is eligible for the 0% VAT export rate under the Export Tax Rebate regime only if: (1) the WFOE is the exporter of record on the customs export declaration, not merely an agent; (2) the goods physically leave mainland China and are cleared into Taiwan as a separate customs territory; (3) the WFOE is a VAT General taxpayer and has valid VAT special input invoices; (4) the export sale is supported by a genuine commercial

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBoC) and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE); cross-strait settlement clearing coordination is effectuated through the Bank of Taiwan Taipei branch under the Cross-Strait Currency Settlement Agreement, while the People's Bank of China remains the central regulatory authority for all onshore PRC foreign-exchange matters
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The PRC maintains a managed floating exchange-rate regime with comprehensive current-account convertibility but strict capital-account controls. For a China-domiciled WFOE, inbound FDI equity subscriptions enter through the capital account and are registered with SAFE under the Foreign Investment Information Reporting System. These funds must be credited to a capital settlement account, settled into RMB through a bank-conducted capital settlement procedure, and ring-fenced for lawful business operations only. Current-account receipts from exporting dried goji berries and herbal botanicals are convertible into RMB after trade verification, allowing the exporter to retain foreign exchange or voluntarily settle at a designated bank; no mandatory surrender ratio is imposed. Profit repatriation to a Taiwan parent is feasible but only after year-end audit completion, tax settlement, submission of audited financial statements and a board resolution to the remitting bank; the outbound dividend is then processed as a current-account item. Onshore hedging remains tightly regulated, requiring genuine trade background, and access to offshore NDF markets is limited. The overall assessment is therefore a semi-convertible current-account system with capital-project liberation reserved for qualifying FDI and trade flows, and with compliance dependence on SAFE registration, bank verification, and demonstrable economic substance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from the dried goji berry and herbal wholesale business must be repatriated into China generally within 180 days of the customs export declaration, either by returning the foreign currency to a designated foreign-currency settlement account or by converting it to RMB at a licensed bank. There is no statutory mandatory conversion ratio; SAFE allows exporters to retain 100% of export receipts in foreign currency or to settle 100% into RMB at their discretion. All proceeds must nevertheless be declared on the Trade Foreign Exchange Monitoring System, and the bank must verify the supporting customs declaration, commercial invoice, packing list, and bill of lading. Offshore retention beyond the 180-day window is permitted only with a valid SAFE offshore retention filing or prior approval for specific trade structures.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low legal feasibility for servicing the WFOE entity. Under the PBOC Payment Licensing Rules and SAFE cross-border payment supervision, domestic non-bank undertakings cannot legally operate conventional EMI services, issue e-money corporate accounts, or launch cross-border payment/collection accounts for a PRC-incorporated WFOE without obtaining a Chinese payment institution license and SAFE trade-monitoring approval. Offshore digital EMIs such as Airwallex, Revolut Business, or Currencycloud are not licensed to receive equity capital contributions into the WFOE capital account, nor can they validly disburse trade payments while bypassing an onshore commercial bank. They may only serve as auxiliary payment-billing rails when partnered with a licensed Chinese bank or a qualified third-party payment processor like Alipay Global or Tenpay Global, and the underlying settlement must still pass through the domestic Tier-1 bank. The recommended viability rating is 'not substitutable'; the primary account architecture must rest on licensed PRC commercial banks, while EMI rails are limited to low-order receivable aggregation and minor ancillary FX automation.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: The statutory legal representative of the WFOE must appear physically at the chosen Chinese commercial bank branch for the initial corporate account opening and the mandatory KYC underwriting interview. The branch compliance team will verify the business license, seals, passport and residence permit, UBO declaration, and will conduct a recorded conversation on the business model, counterparties, and source of funds. Remote consular proxy opening is generally not accepted for the opening of capital escrow accounts; in exceptional second-phase administration tasks, a notarized and authenticated power of attorney from the Taiwan-parent board may allow a local finance manager to perform operational account changes, but the legal representative must still be reachable by a live video interview and a physical identity check is strongly preferred for all signatories listed on the banking mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity caused by a Taiwan parent chain and possible nominee arrangements without clear economic substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation and memorandum of the Taiwan parent; complete share register and beneficial ownership disclosure identifying all natural persons with at least 10% ownership; notarized board resolutions appointing the WFOE directors; three years of audited financial statements; corporate structure chart with a written statement of actual control; passport copies and residential proof for each director; and a statutory declaration confirming the absence of nominee or transaction-disguising structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade typology mismatch where dried goji berries and herbal botanicals are incorrectly classified as controlled medicinal herbs or plant-derived products requiring a special licensing regime
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official market-supervision and NMPA classification statement confirming the product is a food or botanical wholesale item outside the controlled-drug list; HS classification certificate; customs commodity notification; phytosanitary certificate; certificate of origin; organic certification where claimed; GCC or health inspection permits; laboratory analysis certifying pesticides, heavy metals, and mycotoxin compliance; commercial sales contracts naming bona-fide end users; and a full supplier traceability dossier.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unsupported source of FDI because inbound capital is routed through Taiwan as a financial center or via an intermediate Hong Kong LLP without evident operating substance
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) issued by the remitting bank; certified bank statements showing all prior remittance history; economic-commercial explanation of the funds route; audited balance sheet and profit-and-loss statement of the direct investor proving operating substance; tax residence certificate from Taiwan authorities; reciprocal cross-strait tax agreement documentation; a detailed capital source statement, and MOFCOM foreign investment negative-list compliance confirmation issued by the local market supervision authority.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering red flag arising from under-invoicing or over-invoicing of dried goji berry export contracts and inconsistent customs and FX receipts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive trade dossier containing bills of lading, customs declarations, full-value commercial invoices, packing lists, insurance certificates, original letters of credit or documentary collection documents; independent pre-shipment inspection certificate from a third-party quality inspector such as Bureau Veritas or SGS; confirmed purchase orders and term sheets from buyers; a complete email or written contract negotiation trail; SAFE trade and payment balance declarations reflecting that receipts match invoiced values; and an internal trade-pricing policy endorsed by the board.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity capital for the CN WFOE must pass through the SAFE-registered FDI procedure: first the WFOE obtains a Foreign Investment Information Report code from the local foreign-exchange administration; second, the entity opens a dedicated Capital Settlement Account at an authorized Tier-1 commercial bank; third, the Taiwan investor transmits a SWIFT MT103 or MT202 wire quoting the SAFE registration code and clearly denoting the purpose as 'equity injection for registered capital under foreign investment'; fourth, the receiving bank verifies the remitter against the registered shareholder list and performs capital conformity checking; fifth, the funds are recorded as foreign-investment capital and may be settled to RMB through the capital settlement process after verifying that the project is not on the foreign investment negative list; sixth, a Chinese certified public accountant issues a capital verification report after injection, and the WFOE files the report with the local administration for market regulation; and seventh, use of the settled RMB is restricted to lawful business operating expenses, capital construction, and working capital, with customs and VAT documentation retained for audit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for the dried goji berry and herbal wholesale activity are cleared via SWIFT MT103 for open-account payments, commercial letters of credit issued through MT700 with subsequent MT710 amendments and MT202 cover for trade finance settlement, and documentary collections using D/P and D/A instructions through correspondent banks. Each payment must be reconciled against the underlying cargo invoice, packing list, customs declaration, and transport document, and the transaction must be reported through the SAFE Trade Foreign Exchange Monitoring System. For Taiwanese counterparties, cross-strait RMB clearing can be executed through the Bank of China Taipei branch or through the onshore CNH clearing window; USD-denominated settlements follow the normal correspondent-bank chain with the WFOE's designated Chinese bank acting as settlement bank and maintaining the outgoing MT103 audit trail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: SAFE-approved deliverable foreign exchange forwards (primarily USD/CNY, HKD/CNY, and EUR/CNY) strictly for hedging current-account trade receivables and payables with full genuine underlying transactions
Foreign exchange swaps executed onshore with licensed commercial banks in order to manage short-term currency turnover and cash-flow mismatches arising from goji berry export collection cycles

Offshore CNH nondeliverable forwards (NDFs) permitted only as a genuine hedge of real export receivable exposure through an overseas licensed bank; prohibited as a speculative standalone derivative for a mainland WFOE

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps restricted to covering long-term shareholder loans or cross-border debt arrangements that are SAFE-registered and recorded under the macro-prudential foreign debt administration framework

SAFE-approved structured forwards or vanilla currency options with mandatory trade underlying, knock-out or no-knock-out clauses, traded solely through designated PRC commercial banks and never through unlicensed digital platforms

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 20% of net taxable income (Article 5, Income Tax Act; effective for fiscal years beginning 2018 and thereafter).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Investment tax credits under the Statute for Industrial Innovation (eligible R&D expense credit up to 15%, automated equipment credit up to 3%); preferential income exemption for qualifying emerging industries; additional 5% surtax on undistributed retained earnings (Article 66-9 of the Income Tax Act).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (Form 1004/1004A) filed via the National Tax Administration e-Filing Portal (tax.nat.gov.tw).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing period runs from 1 May to 31 May of the year immediately following the taxable year; for a fiscal year ending 31 December, the deadline is 31 May of the succeeding calendar year. Extensions may be granted to 31 August upon application.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total sales revenue from the export of dried goji berries, herbal botanicals, and wholesale trading activities, net of returns, discounts, and sales taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A WFOE must report all revenue in New Taiwan Dollars (NT$) and reconcile with the export declarations and foreign-currency receipts converted at the spot rate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct acquisition, processing, packaging, quality-testing, inventory-carrying, and inbound logistics costs attributable to goods sold.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a WFOE with a mainland-China manufacturing parent, the transfer price paid to the parent must be at arm's length and supported by a transfer pricing study.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 01 less Line 03; gross margin must be commercially justifiable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the gross margin deviates from comparable independent distributors, the tax authority may perform an upward adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling, administrative, legal, audit, rent, salary, telecom, and other ordinary and necessary business expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses paid to foreign related parties (e.g., Chinese holding company management fees) are deductible only if substantiated and at arm's length.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross profit less operating expenses; indicates the taxpayer's routine Taiwan-source operating profit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A WFOE should not report a chronic net operating loss without robust economic substance and market justification, as this triggers transfer pricing red flags.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest income, foreign-exchange gains, government or parent grants, property disposal gains, and other incidental income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-operating income must be declared in full; unreported offshore-account interest may be imputed as unreported taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign-exchange losses, donations, casualty losses, and other non-operating deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions claimed by a WFOE for payments to a mainland-related party (e.g., royalty or service charges) must satisfy the substantive-benefit test and be subject to withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total of operating and non-operating income less total deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The net income figure must match the audited financial statement unless a reconciliation annex is filed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 17 — Taxable Income after Carryforward Losses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net income less any eligible net operating loss carryfoward; Taiwan allows a 10-year carryforward under Article 39 of the Income Tax Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A WFOE with a change in the principal business or ownership may lose the loss-carryforward benefit; document continuity of ownership.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income multiplied by 20%; for small-entity brackets below NT$120,000, special progressive calculation applies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The effective rate for a WFOE normally equals the statutory rate after tax credits; no special preferential reduction applies without a specific statutory incentive.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 23 — Self-Assessed Tax Payable / Net Balance Due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax payable less preliminary payments, withholding credits, and eligible investment-tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any balance due above NT$30,000 is paid in cash through the e-Payment portal; late payment accrues daily interest at the Taiwan Bank prime lending rate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: If not filed by 31 May, an extension penalty of 3% of the tax amount per month (or fraction) is levied up to a maximum of 30% of the tax due; if no tax is due, a fixed fine of NT$10,000 is applied. If the tax authority discovers understated revenue, an additional 1x to 3x understatement penalty is imposed under Article 110 of the Income Tax Act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Provisional Tax Prepayment Statement (Form 1007) filed via the National Tax Administration e-Filing Portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Semi-annual provisional prepayment (two installments per taxable year).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For calendar-year taxpayers: first prepayment by 30 June, second prepayment by 30 November; each installment equals 50% of the prior year's income tax liability unless an alternative estimate is elected.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Actual final tax liability of the immediately preceding taxable year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must base prepayments on the last filed annual return; failure to make provisional payments results in a surcharge.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated current-year tax liability when the taxpayer chooses to calculate under estimated income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A WFOE adopting the estimate method must provide supporting projected financials; overestimates and underestimates are subject to adjustment rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 50% of prior-year tax liability (or 50% of estimated tax, if lower).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any prepayment shortfall is adjusted in the annual return with interest.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to make provisional payments triggers a penalty of the unremitted amount plus interest at the statutory rate; persistent non-payment is treated as tax evasion.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% on dividends distributed to non-resident corporate shareholders, including mainland-China shareholders, under Art. 73 (Income Tax Act) and Art. 73-1 for retained-earnings distributions. Such dividends are subject to final withholding and no further income-tax filing is required for the recipient.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Under the Taiwan Income Tax Act and tax treaties, a non-resident shareholder may claim a reduced withholding rate only where a Double Taxation Agreement is in force. The procedural protocol is: (1) file Form 373 'Application for Reduced Withholding Tax Rate under a Double Taxation Agreement' with the local National Tax Administration before the payment date; (2) attach a Taxpayer Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the tax authority of the treaty‑country (with Chinese seal and English translation); (3) provide a written statement from the company certifying the direct or indirect shareholding percentage, entity type, and actual beneficial ownership; (4) receive an approval letter from the tax administration; and (5) apply the treaty rate at source. For mainland-China shareholders, the Cross‑Strait Agreement on Avoiding Double Taxation (signed 2015) is not yet in force, so no treaty relief is currently available; the 21% statutory rate applies.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest and royalties paid to non-resident related parties (including Chinese parent or IP licensor) are subject to statutory withholding of 20% under Art. 88 of the Income Tax Act. Under Taiwan's DTAs with selected jurisdictions, the treaty rate may be reduced to 10% for interest and 10% for royalties; no reduction applies under the currently inactive Cross-Strait tax protocol. A WFOE paying royalty or interest to a mainland Chinese affiliate must therefore withhold 20%, unless a specific advance pricing agreement or competent authority ruling approves a different rate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File must be prepared where annual cross-border related-party transactions exceed NT$100,000,000; Master File is required when the group's annual global revenue exceeds NT$3,000,000,000 and cross-border intercompany transactions exceed NT$200,000,000; Country-by-Country Report applies when the ultimate parent's consolidated group revenue exceeds NT$27,000,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not directly apply the EU Economic Substances Requirements (ESR), but its income tax law incorporates the Economic Substance Doctrine through Art. 43-1 of the Income Tax Act: transactions undertaken without commercial purpose or whose economic substance is the mere shifting of profits to a low-tax jurisdiction may be recharacterized. The tax authority applies a pragmatic substance analysis to shell WFOEs, requiring real office premises, employees, strategic-decision making, business risk management, local bank accounts, and audited financials. Taiwan's CFC rules (effective 2023) also impute the undistributed earnings of controlled foreign entities in low-tax jurisdictions to their Taiwanese shareholders, further reinforcing the need for substantive local activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately under-reporting sales revenue from dried-goji-berry export transactions, invoicing at below arm's-length prices to a Chinese parent or related distributor, or channeling export proceeds to an offshore bank account outside the WFOE's Taiwan books.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: An understatement penalty of 1 to 3 times the amount of hidden tax under Article 110 of the Income Tax Act; additional criminal fines up to NT$500,000 under Article 36 of the Tax Collection and Enforcement Act; and imprisonment up to five years for intentional tax fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax and penalties; courts can issue travel bans to prevent departure from Taiwan and impose personal asset attachment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the WFOE as a mere mailbox with no Taiwan employees, no business premises, no board meetings in Taiwan, and no real risk-bearing function, while all commercial decisions are made by the Chinese parent; invoices are issued by Taiwan without underlying operational activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority recharacterizes the entire profit as Taiwan-source business income under Article 43-1 and imposes the 20% corporate tax plus a 1x to 3x penalty; the Ministry of Economic Affairs may also revoke the WFOE's business license for exercising the company in a way that violates public order.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally reassessed under a veil-piercing theory if they knowingly allowed the sham structure; they are exposed to criminal sanctions for fraud, administrative revocation of employment visas, and court-imposed injunctions restricting access to Taiwan.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to Withhold Withholding Tax on Profit Repatriation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Distributing dividends to a mainland-China parent without withholding the 21% statutory withholding tax, or paying royalties/interest to a related party without applying 20% withholding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A fine of 20% of the unwithheld tax is imposed on the WFOE as the withholding agent (Article 114 of the Income Tax Act); if the withholding cannot be collected from the non-resident, the WFOE is liable for the full amount of tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The responsible director is personally liable for the unwithheld tax plus penalties, and may be subjected to administrative execution against personal property; repeated non-compliance can trigger a travel ban and criminal prosecution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare, retain, or submit the Local File / Master File when cross-border related-party transactions exceed the statutory thresholds, or submitting incomplete / inconsistent analyses for the dried-goji-berry intercompany sales and licensing arrangements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A monetary penalty of up to NT$50,000 for failure to produce documentation; the tax authority may also disregard the incomplete documentation and perform a discretionary assessment, imposing the 20% tax on an adjusted income plus penalties of up to 5% of the entire transaction value.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally responsible for ensuring accurate and complete TP documentation under the company law duties of care; knowing non-compliance may result in personal fines and a ban on holding company directorships in Taiwan.
